thread:
maria-sales: FYI - Moneta Bank RFP just arrived. They want a 60-day POC (on-prem preferred), mandatory FIPS 140-2 HSM, tenant-level crypto isolation, EU-west-1 residency, and a capability matrix + detailed pricing. Also asked for a submitted security questionnaire and an operator access runbook. Need an initial response + matrix by EOW. Any immediate blockers?

ton y-solutions: Quick clarifying Qs: when they say on-prem, do they mean air-gapped or VPC-hosted with customer-managed network? Also, do they require dedicated GPUs or is virtualized Dedicated capacity acceptable?

maria-sales: @tony-solutions their note: "on-prem or customer VPC (no public internet routes), hardware HSM preferred, strict egress controls, logs must stream to their Splunk via peering or direct-forwarding." They flagged SLA requirements for 99.9% inference availability during business hours.

hannah-eng: We can support both models. For VPC-hosted Private deployment, we can run our control plane in their VPC with customer-managed endpoints (no public routing). For air-gapped on-prem, we'll need an engineering engagement for packaging and offline install. Recommend baseline: 3x GPU nodes (A100-class) for the POC to capture latency/throughput.

hannah-eng: HSM integration notes: we support PKCS#11 and KMIP. Fallback behavior: we can configure a KMS-wrapped fallback key (customer-managed) that activates only when the HSM client reports unreachable; every fallback event is logged to an append-only audit stream for compliance. We'll include sample config snippet in the matrix.

nina-security: For the questionnaire I'll need vendor FIPS attestation, operator MFA proof, KMS rotation policy, and an explanation of how we prove non-repudiation of fallback events. Also we need to confirm whether operator consoles can be restricted to a jump-host and whether logs are WORM. I'll mark any hard constraints.

ton y-solutions: Draft capability matrix items I'm planning: row per deployment mode (hosted API / dedicated / private-VPC / on-prem), HSM support (PKCS11/KMIP), key rotation & destruction notes, network models (peering/jump-host/air-gap), SIEM integration, streaming & tool-calling, model quantization support, per-tenant isolation, and SLA tiers.

maria-sales: Pricing thoughts: propose two POC offers - (A) 60-day on-prem trial: $30k one-time engineering + $2k/week run costs; (B) 60-day VPC-based private trial: $12k flat + usage pass-through. Also propose enterprise onboarding/add-on: 24/7 support for extra $8k/mo. Please sanity-check numbers.

hannah-eng: Suggested POC ops timeline:
```
- Week -1: Contract + NDAs, access plan, network checklist
- Week 0: Infra provisioning (3 GPUs), MFA + operator accounts
- Week 1: Deploy private control plane, basic model tests
- Week 2: HSM integration (vendor test keys), run sample load
- Week 3: Failover/fallback exercise, latency benchmarks
- Week 4: SIEM integration + audit review
- Week 5-7: Customer acceptance tests, tuning
- Week 8: Final report & handoff
```

nina-security: A couple of notes for questionnaire answers: quarterly key rotation with provable destruction is requested. We can do rotation; provable physical destruction depends on the HSM vendor. We'll mark as "vendor attestation required" and request a vendor-signed statement. Also request their legal to accept our published SOC2 + FIPS docs.

ton y-solutions: Sample KMIP snippet for matrix notes:
```
kmip_endpoint: kmip://10.10.0.5:5696
auth: client-cert (mTLS)
wrap: AES-GCM-256
rotation: customer-scheduled, automation via control plane
notes: requires HSM vendor cert chain for attestation
```

maria-sales: Action items: @tony-solutions draft capability matrix + pricing (due TOMORROW 10:00am), @hannah-eng provide HSM config snippets + fallback paragraph (due TODAY 4:00pm), @nina-security finish questionnaire responses + exceptions (due EOD). I'll bundle and send to Moneta and loop in legal.

ci-bot: Artifact stored: s3://redwood-sales/moneta-rfp-1749994321-bundle.zip

maria-sales: Thanks team  let's try to keep answers short and regulatory-friendly. I'll prep a one-page executive summary to include with the matrix.
